name: Twists of My Life
source:
You are a student of law in city "N". You live a normal life, study and meet different people. In short, you do what most people your age do. One day you find yourself in trouble, which causes you to move... and so the story begins.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/novel]Patreon[/url]]
